kept_lines: Choose the level of bookkeeping support that fits your business today.

Enjoy our intelligent platform, mobile app and client portal. Subscribers have access to an accounting expert for training and bookkeeping services by appointment only. This package is perfect for customers needing troubleshooting, transaction structure review, training, or clean-up catch-up work performed as needed. Custom Hourly work will be performed at $75/hour and Expert Services $100/hour. Appointments must be made in advance - no on-demand access to your team.
Periodic accounting close functions, financial reporting, sales tax filings, build-out, 1099 processing or accrual basis services.
We have the expertise to perform advanced accounting tasks that go beyond periodic bookkeeping. Here are some of them - if in doubt, just ask.
An account is any bank, credit card, payment clearing, or payroll clearing on your books that experiences 10+ transactions a month. We reconcile Paypal accounts. Less than 10 transactions? It's free!
